proposes: THE ANTI-CLAIMS INSTRUMENT. (1) agents/claims-audit.cjs — offline/keyless/DETERMINISTIC/fail-soft desk that audits the ledger itself: every path-shaped token in feature_list.json evidence (array/string/object shapes) must RESOLVE on the tree (resolution law: as-given -> agents/ -> .github/workflows/ -> unique basename via a deterministic sorted file index); every cited CR must have its change-requests file (0 files = offender); the change-requests directory is scanned for duplicate slot numbers independent of citations; the suite version/count invariant (run-evals source vs committed eval-results.json: MATCH / LAGGING-BOOK / MISMATCH / SKIP; sub-letter ids E40a/b counted); STASIS halt-before-read via stasisHalt required from the census desk (second-mover law — the SAME brake, never a copy); CLAIMS_AUDIT_SKIP seam; single-writer atomic book agents/claims-audit.json (+ at-free .md so the md can never cause a publish diff); stable payload byte-deterministic. (2) THE OWNER-LANGUAGE LAW encoded as data (roles-as-data: a rule not encoded is not a rule): OWNER_LANGUAGE='he' — owner-facing replies are HEBREW, repo/CI artifacts stay English; printed on every run, guarded by E41. (3) WIRED: claims-audit rides fleet-census-cron.yml as an independent leg (zero extra Actions minutes, their reslotted 14 2 * * * minute kept), AND the publish step gains the NO-NOISE COMPARATOR — the roast found the latent defect that the published books carry a moving at-stamp, so the old plain `git diff --cached --quiet` would have committed daily timestamp noise, making the workflow header's own 'clean exit' claim a lie; the comparator now strips at and compares stable payloads against HEAD (the claim and the mechanism agree at last). (4) E41 in run-evals v1.28.0 -> v1.29.0 (on top of the pulse lane's E40a/b, kept): resolution-order white-box (workflows/basename fallbacks + honest miss), three-shape evidence collectors, the suiteInvariant machine, real-tree zero-offenders on the MERGED tree, reason-stamped exceptions, CR-0008 duplicate-slot warn, claimsStable byte-determinism, OWNER_LANGUAGE='he', and the REAL desk fresh-process black-box. (5) THE ROAST FINDINGS (all verified against the tree this rung): [F1] the lane wrote owner-facing summaries in CHINESE to a Hebrew-speaking owner — a direct communication failure, now outlawed by the encoded law; [F2] the lane's context summary claimed HEAD=a1f190a with 'next=feat-035' while the estate was actually at a3acd36 (Rung 19/20, CR-0048/feat-043) and feat-035 had ALREADY landed as CR-0041 — stale claims presented as current state; the recovery law is: re-scan git+ledger+worklog BEFORE claiming anything; [F3] 'ONE-BLOC 16/16 tokenReach 14' is ENVIRONMENT-CONDITIONAL — re-measured keyless this rung: reached=2, authWall=14, tokenReach=0 (no token in shell), verdict DEGRADED; the estate itself is intact (census 16/16 fresh-measured) — future claims must carry their measurement conditions; [F4] ledger evidence hygiene measured on the merged tree: 62 path tokens across 44 feats, 59 resolve mechanically, 3 are documented exceptions (sovereign-pending.json runtime mailbox; traj-gwt1/2.json ephemeral drill artifacts; fills.jsonl ledger shorthand) — booked as reason-stamped ALLOWED-CLAIM WARNs, never silently ignored, never fake failures; [F5] CR-0008 is a genuine historical DUPLICATE-SLOT (two different CR-0008 files, two waves ~1h apart) — kept by the immutability law, now WARNed by the desk forever; [F6] the lane's own tools were caught lying FIVE times during the roast itself (a raw scanner reported 5 missing evidence paths — 4 were resolution artifacts + 1 exception; the desk regex truncated .json to .js via alternation order; the evalr count counted catch-blocks, 39 evals as 78, then dropped sub-letter ids E40a/b and finally a mandatory quantifier broke plain ids — the count fix took four swings, each caught by printing actual values instead of trusting hand results; the eval checked a Map with Object.keys; a dot-dir-blind glob hid .github/workflows) — each caught, each fixed, E41 guards forever.
rationale: The fleet's whole epistemology rests on claims that are checked: fills read back from the chain, ledgers diffed, evals run fresh-process. But the LEDGER ITSELF (feature_list evidence, CR files, suite counts) was never mechanically audited — the roast directive exposed that the lane could write stale state, foreign languages, and environment-conditional numbers as if they were facts. An audit desk makes the anti-claims law RETESTABLE on every cadence: a claim that loses its file becomes an offender the next morning, automatically, keyless. The owner-language law belongs in the same instrument because a claim in a language the owner cannot read is functionally an unverifiable claim.
risk: Low: additive read-only desk + one new workflow step + a publish-step comparator inside the same gated job (STASIS-braked, keyless, [skip ci]); no chain, custody, signing, or trading surface touched. The comparator changes publish semantics conservatively (commits strictly MORE evidence of drift, never less: any non-volatile staged file forces the commit). Suite-count invariant could false-positive when an eval is added without a lane-books commit — modeled as LAGGING-BOOK WARN, self-healing by design. Known desk limitation, honestly booked: combined 'file.json/.md' shorthand tokens parse to no path at all (the desk never judges what it cannot parse, and never excuses what it can).
